hero_kpi_rationale: Mobile revenue is Charter's primary growth driver, up 22% in 2025, driven by the addition of 1.8 million residential lines, despite declines in other services.

kpis.name: Mobile service revenue
kpis.explanation: Revenue generated from mobile services offered to residential customers.
kpis.description: Mobile revenue increased by 22% in 2025, driven by the addition of 1.8 million residential lines.
kpis.signal: Double-digit growth in a mature market

kpis.name: Internet revenue
kpis.explanation: Revenue from broadband Internet services provided to residential and business customers.
kpis.description: Internet revenue grew due to price increases and better bundling allocation, despite a loss of 393,000 residential customers.

kpis.name: Gross margin
kpis.explanation: Difference between revenue and operating costs, excluding depreciation.
kpis.description: Estimated at approximately 59.9% in 2025 (revenue of $54.774B minus operating costs of $32.739B).
kpis.signal: High margin driven by lower programming costs

kpis.name: Operating margin
kpis.explanation: Operating income divided by total revenue.
kpis.signal: Slight margin pressure despite mobile growth

kpis.name: Capital expenditures
kpis.explanation: Spending to expand and improve the network, particularly in rural areas.
kpis.description: $2.2B spent in 2025 on rural deployment, enabling 483,000 new passing locations.
kpis.signal: Targeted capex on rural fiber for sustainable growth

kpis.name: Residential Internet customer losses
kpis.explanation: Number of households that canceled their Spectrum Internet subscription during the period.
kpis.description: Loss of 393,000 residential Internet customers in 2025 (net decline), despite mobile and bundled service growth.

kpis.name: Seamless entertainment allocation
kpis.explanation: Costs allocated to streaming apps included in video bundles.
kpis.description: In 2025, the allocation increased by $322M, reflecting more activated and free included apps.
kpis.signal: Growing integration of third-party apps into the ecosystem

kpis.name: Spectrum App Store launch
kpis.explanation: New digital platform to manage streaming applications.
kpis.description: Launched in July 2025, the store enables users to purchase, activate, and manage streaming apps in one place.
kpis.signal: Digital transformation of the video offering

risks.title: Leverage
risks.score_rationale: The company has high leverage, with debt covenants and restrictions that could affect its liquidity and operations.

risks.title: Interest rate risk
risks.score_rationale: The company is exposed to interest rate risk, with a portion of its debt on variable rates.

risks.title: Foreign exchange risk
risks.score_rationale: The company uses hedging instruments to manage foreign exchange risk, but these are not fully effective.

risks.title: Technology dependence
risks.score_rationale: The company is highly dependent on technology for its operations, making it vulnerable to technological risks.

risks.title: Regulatory risks
risks.score_rationale: The company is subject to strict regulations as a cable operator, which could impact its operations and profitability.

ai_positioning.summary: CHTR does not mention artificial intelligence or machine learning in its 10-K/20-F filing.
